candidates.title: 'Can't beat us, threaten us': Rahul thanks protesters after INDIA bloc march to SC
candidates.excerpt: Rahul Gandhi thanked supporters for gathering in Delhi during the INDIA bloc march, aimed at raising awareness about electoral issues. The protest focused on alleged discrepancies and the Election Commission’s handling of voter deletions. Despite police barricades disrupting the march, Gandhi and fellow leaders moved forward by petitioning the Supreme Court for disclosure of Election Commission documents and measures to prevent unannounced voter deletions.
